source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 4 同主题完形(学读面部表情/在国外误用手势/用动作买牛肉/害羞学生的身体/各地问候方式/微笑实验)。用词限 U4/初中/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Learning to Read Faces
passages.text: When I was young, I thought we only communicated with (1)____. Then a teacher taught me that our faces and hands send messages too. She showed us how a (2)____ frown can mean a person is unhappy, even if they say they are fine. At first I found it hard to (3)____ a real smile from a fake one. But slowly I began to (4)____ small signs that I had missed before. I learned that people often (5)____ their true feelings without meaning to. A friend who keeps looking at the door may be (6)____, while one who leans towards you is usually (7)____. Reading these quiet signs has changed the way I (8)____ with others. Now, before I speak, I take a moment to (9)____ what a person's body is telling me. This new skill has made me a much better (10)____ to my friends.

passages.title: A Gesture That Went Wrong
passages.text: On my first trip abroad, a small hand (1)____ taught me a big lesson. After a nice meal, I made the "OK" sign to the cook to show that the food was (2)____. "The same gesture can (5)____ from place to place," she said. "You should always (6)____ making it until you know the local habits." I felt (7)____ for upsetting the cook, so the next day I went back to (8)____ what I really meant. This time I simply smiled and gave a thumbs-up, and he smiled (9)____. passages.title: Buying Beef Without Words
passages.text: My grandmother once told me a funny story about (1)____ in America. She did not speak much English, so shopping was a real (2)____ for her. She put both hands up like horns and said, "Moo! Moo!" The clerk laughed, but he understood her at once and (5)____ her to the beef. Grandmother got exactly what she (6)____ without saying a single English word. This little (7)____ showed her that acting can help people (8)____ even across a language gap. "When words fail," she often says, "your body can still (9)____ the message." Now I am never (10)____ to use my hands when I travel somewhere new.

passages.title: The Body of a Shy Student
passages.text: Lin was one of the shyest students in our (1)____. While others raised their hands, he often kept his head (2)____ and his eyes on the desk. passages.title: Greetings Around the World
passages.text: People all over the world say hello, but they do it in many different (1)____. In France and Russia, friends often kiss each other on the (2)____ when they meet. Some cultures (6)____ a gentle nod of the head, while others give a warm hug. None of these is right or (7)____; they are simply different habits. A traveller who learns the local greeting can quickly (8)____ down the wall between strangers. Using the wrong one, on the other hand, may cause a small (9)____. So before you visit a new country, it is wise to find out how the people there like to be (10)____.

passages.title: A Test About Smiling
passages.text: Our science teacher once gave us a simple (1)____ about smiling. She asked half the class to hold a wide smile for two minutes, while the other half kept their faces (2)____.
